data.long_meaning: The name Greiner is of German origin and is composed of two elements: 'grein' meaning power or strength, and '-er' meaning one who has or possesses. Thus, Greiner can be translated as 'the powerful one' or 'the strong one'. The name Greiner carries the meaning “Powerful, strong one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Greiner usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
